proposed_capability: Hand control from verified lab restock to the exact-build existing native responder using one scoped native transition and independently observe decision-making.
player_save_control_impact: Existing exact process, game version, save, lot and input generation remain required. No game access in this executor. Native admission still requires an independently verified Windows binding.
expected_outcome: The existing launcher claims restock control, buys to the current target, clears the picker, transfers ownership to the repository native runtime and records a distinct qualified decision.
negative_tests: Missing qualified ownership holds native effects. Wrong scope, open picker or unsettled cart prevents handoff.
Lost handoff acknowledgement cannot replay. Handoff alone is distinct from observing a native decision.
rollback_path: Revert the named launch feature. No offline test touches game data.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact installed Windows EA bridge, mod activation, decision callback, native effects and player takeover.
